criteria.statement: The release builder publishes only a clean, exact, full Git commit and its output identity is deterministic.
The T1 publisher is constrained to the isolated releases root and never targets the shared CODE tree or formal deployment root.
criteria.check: pytest CODE/scripts/remote/tests/test_release_protocol.py::test_cli_install_cannot_target_the_formal_workspace_or_an_arbitrary_release_root CODE/scripts/remote/tests/test_release_protocol.py::test_t1_exclusions_do_not_change_formal_deployment_policy -q; inspect publisher root guard and rename/install paths

criteria.statement: Publishing refuses tracked secret material and excludes ignored environment, model, and output assets from release contents.
Recovery quarantines incoming and bootstrap remnants, preserves both when a move fails, and leaves an installed release byte-identical.
Same-release install retry is idempotent, conflicting release identity is rejected without overwrite, and old/new releases can coexist for rollback.
A run rejects duplicate run IDs and FORMAL mode, and its receipt binds release, configuration, input hashes, runtime inventory, and execution identity.
Data/model, config, checkpoint metadata, runtime, and authorization identity mismatches fail closed in their applicable T1 or formal gates.
Concurrent runs using one immutable release have isolated outputs and distinct run identities.
Pullback verifies receipt identity and every file hash before atomic local placement; corrupt or interrupted payloads stay quarantined and can be retried cleanly.
Verified deployment-index appends are concurrency-safe and duplicate records are idempotent without accepting identity conflicts.
The maintenance checker is local and read-only, reports malformed state without crashing, and never deletes or rewrites dirty evidence.
CI runs the maintenance check and collects CODE/scripts/remote/tests alongside the existing suites.
criteria.check: parse .github/workflows/test.yml and assert one run step invokes maintenance_check.py and the pytest command includes CODE/scripts/remote/tests; inspect exact-head GitHub pytest check before merge

criteria.statement: The environment files separately identify Linux aarch64 Conda artifacts, 88 exact PyPI versions, direct/test dependencies, and missing wheel hashes; they do not claim reproducibility before isolated reconstruction.
criteria.check: validate lock syntax and unique package pins; compare CODE/dependencies/t1-vm-linux-aarch64/README.md with all three requirement files and the explicit Conda lock

criteria.statement: README, AGENTS, and STATUS agree on operational entry points, authority of local governance documents, and the boundary between historical evidence and new release evidence.
criteria.check: inspect README.md, AGENTS.md, STATUS.md and confirm STATUS states new release/run/receipt remain pending until exact PR integration and T1 verification

criteria.statement: The public change contains only the scoped governance implementation and sanitized metadata; raw data, models, credentials, local private paths, and old formal deployment contents are absent.
criteria.check: inspect changed-path list and added-line secret/path scan; confirm no tracked changes under Results/, out/, CODE/data/, old formal deployment, or private evidence directories
